name: MarkedSimpleGalls
source:
def MarkedSimpleGalls : Prop :=
  ∀ (h : SuppressedVertex N) (e f : SuppressedEdge N), e≠f →
    MarkedIncoming N ports e h → MarkedIncoming N ports f h →
    ∃ (a : SuppressedVertex N) (W : List (SuppressedEdge N)),
      (originalGraph (suppressedGraph N ports)).IsCycleThrough e h a W ∧ f∈W ∧
        ∀ d ∈ e::W, d≠e → d≠f → suppressedMark N ports d = .undirected

name: incomingID
source:
def incomingID (e : E) : SuppressedEdge N :=
  if hs : N.graph.source e=N.root then .inr () else .inl ⟨e,hs⟩

name: OrdinaryAvoid
source:
def OrdinaryAvoid (h : V) (e : E) : Prop :=
  ¬N.graph.IsHybrid (N.graph.target e) ∧ N.graph.source e≠h ∧ N.graph.target e≠h

name: SuppressedOrdinaryAvoid
source:
def SuppressedOrdinaryAvoid (h : V) (e : SuppressedEdge N) : Prop :=
  suppressedMark N ports e = .undirected ∧
    ((suppressedGraph N ports).source e).val≠h ∧
    ((suppressedGraph N ports).target e).val≠h
